headline: Draft release proposal remains held: history is preserved, but Morrowind cadence is unfavorable and current-main merge readiness is unqualified.
scope: The reported campaign compares cumulative S 208e4596832a1f949bd63822d5ddd962c4575067, tested through tree-identical baseline source 3caf5d85423298c62344f8fe44fe9a1176b8ae81 and executable fe8047f60181672170524cf40b2151f335f0e232d749b569b60fd5bc2cb5d6ba, with ancestry-preparation candidate dfe9aadf158af5e8808c109e5a48802377f23a7e, tree 354f00baffb8e5bacbfb7a1ac024228c7709bd1e and executable bf50e1005f122c43b1a6845f72b3e39c0cd1ed912192e0a9cc992a95bfcc9116. Historical main 586de4f32c11001c0abe072c3530236f1571b372 is an ancestry parent, not the timing baseline. Current report head dce89f5c12125cfb4a9416a666c84994da0981e2 adds evidence. Main later advanced independently to bd1fecb93353272dda2a810991e28945de35b665, including merged #53; these measurements do not qualify the current-main diff. Morrowind has one pair per renderer; PGR2 values average two runs per build. Cadence is an NV2A guest display-write proxy, not rendered FPS.
